'''''Rescue 1''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It participated in an [[Capture of the Death Star design team|operation]] to capture members of the team which had designed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] after the Rebel Alliance learned they were being transported to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Immortal/Legends|''Immortal'']]. While [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]] and [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadrons]] provided cover, ''Rescue 1'' was able to dock to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Godar]]'' for the boarding operation, before escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] after successfully completing the mission.<ref name="X-Wing" />
